vehicle.notes: Research limited to web-search result pages (titles/snippets of eBay, parts retailers and TecDoc OE cross-reference listings); the session network blocked direct page fetches and EPC mirrors (7zap, partsouq, dealer webstores), so no number here has been checked against a VIN-based GM/Opel EPC. Many parts differ pre-facelift (2015-2019) vs facelift (2019-2021), hatchback vs Sports Tourer, and by PDC/sensors. source_url is the search-result page judged to carry the number, but pages were not opened, so a few source_url mappings may point to a sibling listing. Verify against VIN before use in a report.

parts.notes: Pre-facelift (2015-2019) hatchback; eBay.de title 'Opel Astra K vor Facelift Bj. 2015-2019 Stoßstange Vorne Orig. (PDC) 39052730' (not for OPC-Line) and UK eBay 'VAUXHALL ASTRA K HATCHBACK FRONT BUMPER 2015-ON 39052730'. PDC/non-PDC applicability not settled. 39017250 seen as a cross-reference (relationship not stated). Note: one UK listing under this number is a CAPA-certified aftermarket copy.

Two eBay listings tie 13499384 to the Astra K upper front grille (one 2015-2022, one 2015-2019; DP Car Parts listing). 321288108 shown as another manufacturer number on one listing. Finish (black/chrome) variant not established.

eBay listing for 2017 Astra K bonnet gives MPN 39054067 with reference OE 39037562; Autodoc lists Prasco OP4203130 Astra K bonnet with OE 39054067. Caution: one eBay.de listing associates these numbers with a bonnet damper and a facelift part; facelift/pre-facelift applicability not established.

eBay listing '2019 Vauxhall ASTRA K Passenger Front Wing 39011390' (2016-2022, notes superseded number); Winparts lists 39011390 as Opel original for an Astra K front wing but that page does not state the side. Right-hand number not found.
Single eBay listing (2015-on Astra K front right arch liner, genuine OE number). Left-hand number not found.

UK listing '2017 Vauxhall Astra K MK7 headlight, left passenger side nearside 39047200' (halogen) and German listing (left). Cross-referenced with 13488971 and 39081894 (relationship not stated). RHD-specific fit NOT verified in an EPC; LED/Matrix headlamps are different parts.

eBay UK 'genuine Vauxhall Astra K driver's side headlight, part 39081895' (2015-2022) and eBay.de 'SCHEINWERFER RECHTS VAUXHALL ASTRA K 2018 HALOGEN 39081895'. RHD-specific fit NOT verified in an EPC; LED/Matrix headlamps are different parts.
Two eBay listings give 13401154 for the Astra K (Mk7) front fog lamp (one states right-hand, also Zafira C). Left-hand number not found.

Pre-facelift hatchback. Listing 'Vauxhall ASTRA 2015 on 5 Door Hatchback Passengers Rear Lamp 39099014'; catalogue cross-reference 13401160 / 39099014 / 39015943 (supersession order not stated). Sports Tourer uses different lamps.

Pre-facelift hatchback. Listing 'Vauxhall ASTRA Drivers Side Rear Light 2015 to 2019 Genuine Part No 39099015' and 'Offside Rear Outer Light' listing; catalogue cross-reference 13401161 / 39099015 / 39015944 (supersession order not stated).

Hatchback 2015 onward. UK eBay 'Vauxhall ASTRA K Mk7 Rear Bumper 13425478 Genuine'; also a German eBay listing and Marsoni 1808055 cross-reference. PDC applicability CONFLICTS between sources (one says without PDC, one with PDC) - verify sensor holes. Sports Tourer rear bumper is a different part.

Single eBay listing for genuine Vauxhall radiator, 1.4 Turbo petrol (92kW/110kW) hatch and estate, 2020-2023 (facelift). Other engines use different numbers (e.g. 39095604/13453905 listed for 1.4 B14XE; not verified).

Engine-specific: 1.4 B14XE 100PS (06.2015-09.2021). Listed as Opel original number with 39131675 on multiple aftermarket cross-references (NRF 350339, Nissens 940735, Van Wezel 37015704, AVA OL5739D); which of 39010376/39131675 is current is not shown. 1.6 Turbo uses 39011385/39131676/13475956 (not verified).
